body.query: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.

raw_response.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.time
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE g.chain_id = 11
ORDER BY t.time;
raw_response.query: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.

reason.answer: The query returns a single column listing every distinct transaction time-of-day observed at gas stations of chain 11, with duplicate times removed and values sorted chronologically.
reason.business:
- Identify transactions that occurred at gas stations belonging to the specified chain.
- Keep only the time-of-day attribute for those transactions.
- Remove duplicate times so each distinct clock time appears once.
- Order the resulting times chronologically for easy reading.
